payload.text:
Ranked by diameter:
#5 The Moon: 3,475 km
#4 Io: 3,643 km, the most volcanically active world in the solar system
#3 Callisto: 4,821 km, the most heavily cratered
#2 Titan: 5,150 km, the only moon with a thick atmosphere
#1 Ganymede: 5,262 km, the only moon known to have its own magnetic field
Ganymede and Titan are both wider than the planet Mercury (4,879 km).

Sources:
NASA NSSDCA fact sheets (diameters from listed radii): https://nssdc.gsfc.nasa.gov/planetary/factsheet/joviansatfact.html https://nssdc.gsfc.nasa.gov/planetary/factsheet/saturniansatfact.html https://nssdc.gsfc.nasa.gov/planetary/factsheet/moonfact.html https://nssdc.gsfc.nasa.gov/planetary/factsheet/mercuryfact.html
NASA Science, Ganymede facts: https://science.nasa.gov/jupiter/jupiter-moons/ganymede/facts/
NASA Science, Titan facts: https://science.nasa.gov/saturn/moons/titan/facts/

Images: NASA / JPL / USGS (Moon and Io, Galileo), NASA / JPL / DLR (Callisto, Galileo), NASA / JPL / Space Science Institute (Titan, Cassini), NASA / JPL (Ganymede, Galileo). Narration uses a synthetic voice.
